_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Sampeyan lagi dolanan Klondike Solitaire. Tujuan sampeyan yaiku mindahake kabeh kertu menyang tumpukan pondasi.

Aturan Dolanan:
- Tumpukan pondasi (F1-F4): Bangun saka As nganti Raja miturut jinis
- Tumpukan meja (T1-T7): Bangun mudhun kanthi warna selang-seling (abang ing ireng, ireng ing abang)
- Stok: Jupuk kertu menyang tumpukan limbah
- Limbah (W): Kertu paling ndhuwur bisa dimainake

Pitakon:
- 'draw' - Jupuk kertu saka stok menyang limbah
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Mindahake kertu antarane tumpukan
  Tuladha: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count uga bisa 'all', sing bakal njarwakake mindahake kabeh kertu sing madhep munggah.
- 'forfeit' - Mandhegake dolanan langsung lan kunci skor saiki
- Jeneng tumpukan: W (limbah), F1-F4 (pondasi), T1-T7 (meja)

Sampeyan bisa nglakokake aksi-aksi akeh ing siji giliran kanthi misahake karo koma:
  Tuladha: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Mung Raja sing bisa dipasang ing tumpukan meja kosong.
Aksi-aksi dijalankan miturut urutan - yèn siji gagal, aksi-aksi sing isih bakal dilewati.
Gunakake 'forfeit' yèn sampeyan percaya dolanan iku ora bisa dimenangake.
